[[File:The_Gauntlet_Race_Track.png|thumb|250px|The Gauntlet]]
{{Quote|Here he is, the host you all know and love, I'm sure. The all-seeing, all-knowing master with a master key, Warden Fenn Booda!|Fode Annodue introduces Fenn Booda to Podrace spectators on Oovo IV|<ref name="E1R" />}}
'''The Gauntlet''' was one of three [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] courses located on the barren [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]]. Like all of the Oovo IV Podrace courses, The Gauntlet sped through the maximum security [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Desolation Alley]], but was otherwise the only course that sped outside of the prison facility and onto the moon's rocky surface. The outside portions of the course were only weakly protected by a [[Ray shield/Legends|energy shield]], which put [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] in the path of oncoming meteors; The Gauntlet was specifically hosted during meteor showers, courtesy of the prison [[Warden/Legends|wardens]].

During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the crowd favorite was the [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] pilot [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]], who performed in his [[Ord Pedrovia/Legends|''Ord Pedrovia'']] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] and scored record lap and race times. Like all Oovo IV courses, events on The Gauntlet were hosted by Warden [[Fenn Booda]]. The entirety of Desolation Alley was destroyed during the [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], which lasted from [[25 ABY/Legends|25]] to [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].

==Description==
[[File:Gasgano_on_Oovo_IV.png|thumb|left|200px|Gasgano, who was the crowd favorite during 32 BBY, navigates The Gauntlet]]
Located on the barren [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]], which orbited the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Oovo]], The Gauntlet was one of three race courses built<ref name="Nint" /> in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Correctional Authority/Legends|Correctional Authority]]<ref name="SWE" /> [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Desolation Alley]] that was used for the sport of [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]]. While the other two courses, [[Vengeance (Oovo IV)|Vengeance]] and [[Executioner (course)/Legends|Executioner]], wove through the prison, The Gauntlet was the only track that sped outside of the well [[Ray shield/Legends|protected]] facilities and onto the moon's rocky surface.<ref name="Prima" /> The track began in an arena inside the prison, where all of the Oovo IV races began, and quickly sped into an opening stretch of track that all of the courses wove through. However, The Gauntlet split from the previous routes near a large gate, which pushed [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] through a straight, transparent hex tube that connected the shielded facilities to the moon's surface.<ref name="E1R" />

Although the surface was protected by a weak energy dome,<ref name="Prima" /> this area of the moon's surface was known to be pelted by an annual meteor shower that consisted of marble sized rocks smashing into the ground at high-velocity speeds. The prison's [[Warden/Legends|wardens]], headed by the governing warden and race host [[Fenn Booda]], primarily hosted The Gauntlet during these showers, to provide the competitors with an extra challenge.<ref name="Nint" />

Once outside, pilots could take on of two paths to reach the next stage of the course. Pilots could either choose to head back inside of the protective facility, or they could veer to the right before reentering the facility and remain on an outside path. The outside path was considerably shorter, but it was not connected to the main course, forcing pilots to fly over unpaved terrain which greatly slowed down their pods. In addition, there were far more obstacles, such as rocky outcroppings, to avoid when remaining outside. For pilots who had gone back into the shielded facility, there were two paths that could be taken to reach the next stage. Pilots could either go up a ramp between two watch towers that would lead to a bridge, or pilots could simply avoid the ramp and continue straight through the concrete and metal path. All three roads met at the same spot, however, which was another, yet briefer, tenure outside of the protective facility. The second outside portion of the track wove around and under several large rock towers. The meteor shower, however, did not reach this portion of the track.<ref name="E1R" />

Pilots who were able to navigate the rocks would then speed through a large, constructed tunnel that led into a small pit that veered right, where pilots entered another tunnel. After that, [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracers]] would, once again, fly outside for a brief flat stretch of uphill roadway before entering a circular, pit-like [[Cell Block D]] that spun back into Desolation Alley.<ref name="Prima" /> After a series of bridges and wall-hugging roads that sped past several prison facilities, pilots took on the last stretch of the course, which sped through the track's only [[Gravity/Legends|anti-gravity]] tunnel. Like the anti-gravity tunnels on the other Oovo IV courses, this one had been stocked with chunks of [[Ore/Legends|ore]],<ref name="E1R" /> courtesy of Booda and the other wardens.<ref name="Nint" /> Any pilots who had survived the tunnel were shot back out into the starting arena. A standard tournament race on the course would last for three consecutive laps.<ref name="E1R" />

==History==
{{Quote|I've seen better in Watto's Junkyard.|Gasgano would occasionally taunt other pilots before a race|translated=1|audio=Gasgano-taunt.flac|<ref name="E1R" />}}
[[File:Fenn_Booda_hosts.png|thumb|right|250px|The wardens of Desolation Alley were responsible for hosting The Gauntlet during meteor showers.]]
The Gauntlet was constructed on Oovo IV<ref name="E1R" /> by or during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC1">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The racing season presented in the [[Star Wars video games|game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'' must have taken place during this year due to the appearances of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which correspond to ''The Phantom Menace''.</ref> and was the second to last course on the [[Invitational Podracing Circuit]], following the track [[Abyss (Ord Ibanna)|Abyss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Ibanna]], and preceding the track [[Inferno (track)|Inferno]], located on the world of [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]]. Only pilots who had successfully beaten the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] could participate in The Gauntlet.<ref name="E1R" />

One such pilot was the [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]],<ref name="E1R" /> who eventually scored record lap and race times on The Gauntlet. Ultimately, Gasgano was hailed as the crowd's favorite pilot for the course. Flying his [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Ord Pedrovia/Legends|''Ord Pedrovia'']], Gasgano's records included a lap time of ''02.13.076'' [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] and a record race time of ''06:44.576'' minutes.<ref name="Nint" /> Just like the other Oovo IV races, The Gauntlet was hosted by warden Fenn Booda.<ref name="E1R" /> It has been suggested that pilots should equip their Podracers with good [[Coolant pump/Legends|coolant pumps]] and repair modules if they wished to race The Gauntlet.<ref name="Nint" /> During the [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War]],<ref name="SWE2" /> which lasted from [[25 ABY/Legends|25]] to [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Desolation Alley and its facilities were completely destroyed.<ref name="SWE2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gauntlet first appeared in the [[1999]]<ref name="IGN">{{WebCite|url=http://www.ign.com/games/star-wars-episode-i-racer/n64-10490|text=Star Wars: Episode I: Racer - Nintendo 64 - IGN|work=[http://www.ign.com IGN]|archivedate=20170909020128}}</ref> [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'', and was chronologically the third race to be held on Oovo IV. The course could only be unlocked after placing first place in every race for the [[Galactic Podracing Circuit/Legends|Galactic Podracing Circuit]].<ref name="E1R" /> Information and history of the course was detailed in the game's two accompanying [[Star Wars: Episode I Racer Official Nintendo Player's Guide|strategy]] [[Star Wars: Episode I Racer: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|guides]], which were released alongside the game.<ref name="Nint" /><ref name="Prima" /> Although The Gauntlet was not mentioned by name, [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' revealed that Desolation Alley was completely leveled during the Yuuzhan Vong War,<ref name="SWE2">{{CSWECite|II|Oovo 4}}</ref> an event first introduced in the [[1999]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'', written by [[R. A. Salvatore]].<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>
